questions.prompt: ____ team of two girls succeeded in reaching _______ top of K2, the second highest mountain in the world.
questions.explanation:
(c) A; the
‘Top’ mentioned in the given sentence is
specific and we generally use the definite
article ‘the’ before a specific noun. The
two girls are not specified in the
sentence, therefore article ‘the’ cannot be
used before the noun ‘team’. ‘Team’
starts with a consonant sound, therefore
article ‘a’ will be used. Hence, ‘A; the’ is
the most appropriate answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: If the weather forecast proves accurate, we ______ heavy snowfall in the region tomorrow.
questions.explanation:
(a) should have
‘Should’ is used to express a prediction
or an expectation. In the given sentence,
‘should’ has been used to express an
expectation that we should have heavy
snowfall in the region if the weather
forecast proves accurate. Hence, ‘should
have’ is the most appropriate answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: He gave _________ the gift before ______ left for the airport.
questions.explanation:
(a) her, she
We use an objective case(me, us, you,
him, her, them) as the object and
subjective case (I, we, you, he, she, they)
as the subject of a sentence. The first
blank requires an object and the second
blank requires a subject. Hence, ‘her, she’
is the most appropriate answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: After the storm ____, the explorers realised that their campsite had been completely flooded.
questions.explanation:
(c) had subsided
If two actions took place in the past then
the 1st action must be in the Past perfect
tense(Had + V ) and the 2nd action must
3
be in the Simple Past tense(V ). However,
2
the V form of ‘subside’ is ‘subsided’.
3
Hence, ‘had subsided(V )’ is the most
3
appropriate answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: Rashid was not able to ______ the pain after the accident.
questions.explanation:
(d) bear
‘Bear’ means to tolerate pain, hardship,
etc. The given sentence states that
Rashid was not able to bear the pain
after the accident. Hence, ‘bear’ is the
most appropriate answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: No other book in the series captivated readers as _____as the final installment.
questions.explanation:
(a) much
‘As + positive degree + as’ is the correct
grammatical structure. ‘Much’ is a
positive degree adverb while ‘many’ is a
positive degree adjective. In the given
sentence, we need an adverb to modify
the verb ‘captivated’. Hence, ‘much’ is the
most appropriate answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: Luck does not always favour us, so we must always depend _______ our own efforts for success.
questions.explanation:
(d) upon
The verb ‘depend’ always takes the
preposition ‘on/upon’. Hence, ‘upon’ is
the most appropriate answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: The mango is the _________ fruit.
questions.explanation:
(d) sweetest
We generally use the definite article ‘the’
with the superlative degree adjective.
‘Sweetest’ is the superlative degree of
‘sweet’. Hence, ‘sweetest’ is the most
appropriate answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: Mr. Amit Kumar, Proprietor of Xyling Pens is known for _______ honesty and decent behaviour in the business arena.
questions.explanation:
(c) his
‘His’ is used for a singular male subject.
Similarly, in the given sentence, ‘Mr. Amit
Kumar’ is a singular male subject. Hence,
‘his’ is the most appropriate answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: Prescription safety glasses provide the _______ tailored protection for individuals with vision correction needs.
questions.explanation:
(a) finest
We generally use the definite article ‘the’
before a superlative degree. ‘Finest’ is
the superlative degree of ‘fine’. Hence,
‘finest’ is the most appropriate answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: The blueberries in the basket are blue. The denotation of the word 'blue' is _____.
questions.explanation:
(c) a colour.
Blueberries have a blue colour. Hence, ‘a
colour’ is the most appropriate answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: The comedian's jokes were so funny that the entire audience erupted in ______.
questions.explanation:
(c) laughter
The given sentence states that the
comedian’s jokes were so funny that the
entire audience erupted in laughter.
Hence, ‘laughter’ is the most appropriate
answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: This is the ______ book that I have read till now.
questions.explanation:
(b) most interesting
We generally use the definite article ‘the’
before a superlative degree. Superlative
degree denotes the form of an adjective
that expresses the highest degree of a
quality. ‘Most interesting’ is the correct
superlative degree. (Correct)

questions.prompt: Rabindranath Tagore, ______ poet, was famous for his poetical work, Gitanjali.
questions.explanation:
(d) the.
‘Poet’ mentioned in the sentence is
specific and we generally use the definite
article ‘the’ before a specific noun.
Hence, ‘the’ is the most appropriate
answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: Technology has made it possible for us to reach out to more students, and it has also made it possible for us to deliver the same lessons in a much more ________ manner.
questions.explanation:
(b) resourceful
‘Resourceful’ means to able to find and
use different ways to achieve your goals.
The given sentence states that
technology has also made it possible for
us to deliver the same lessons in a much
more resourceful manner. Hence,
‘resourceful’ is the most appropriate
answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: You can tell yourself that you would be willing to lose everything you have in order to get something you want: all of those things you're willing to lose are what make you _________.
questions.explanation:
(a) recognisable
‘Recognisable’ means easy to identify or
recognise. The given sentence states
that all of those things you’re willing to
lose are what make you recognisable.
Hence, ‘recognisable’ is the most
appropriate answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: Select the most appropriate form and tense of the bracketed verb in the following sentence to fill in the blank. I'm busy today. I'd rather we _______ (has) the meeting tomorrow.
questions.explanation:
(a) had
Simple past tense is used after “would
rather / ’d rather” when the subjects are
different. In the given sentence, the
subjects ‘I’ and ‘we’ are different.
Therefore, past form(V ) of the verb will
2
be used. Hence, ‘had(V )’ is the most
2
appropriate answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: The difference between a male and a female still ______ in our society. In this era where women have such great achievements in every field, still in some sections of our community, a man is always termed as superior to women.
questions.explanation:
(d) persists
‘Persist’ means to continue to exist. The
given sentence states that the difference
between a male and a female still
persists in our society. Hence, ‘persists’
is the most appropriate answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: Their plan of acquisition was _______ flawed from the very beginning; it was bound to fail.
questions.explanation:
(c) fatally
‘Fatally’ means in a way that leads to
failure. The given sentence states that
their plan of acquisition was fatally
flawed from the very beginning. It was
bound to fail. Hence, ‘fatally’ is the most
appropriate answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: It may seem _______ that the hours of women's chores at home have not declined inspite of the availability of many appliances (gas, electric ranges, washing machines, etc.)
questions.explanation:
(c) perplexing
‘Perplexing’ means difficult to
understand. The given sentence states
that it may seem perplexing that the
hours of women’s chores at home have
not declined in spite of the availability of
many appliances (gas, electric ranges,
washing machines, etc.) Hence,
‘perplexing’ is the most appropriate
answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: The seven ______ for accreditation were presented in a seminar organised by the university.
questions.explanation:
(a) criteria
The given sentence needs a plural noun
after the plural word ‘seven’. ‘Criteria’ is
the plural form of ‘criterion’. Hence,
‘criteria’ is the most appropriate answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: The business operates ______ the same way as the other businesses did.
questions.explanation:
(c) much
The phrase ‘much the same’ means very
similar. The given sentence states that
the business operates much the same
way as the other businesses did. Hence,
‘much’ is the most appropriate answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: The tree lost many of its ________ in the heavy rain and storm.
questions.explanation:
(b) branches
‘Branch’ is one of the parts of a tree
which grows out from the main trunk.
The given sentence states that the tree
lost many of its branches in the heavy
rain and storm. Hence, ‘branches’ is the
most appropriate answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: A dam is a barrier that stops the flow of water and results in the creation of a______.
questions.explanation:
(d) reservoir
‘Reservoir’ means a place for storing
liquid. The given sentence states that a
dam is a barrier that stops the flow of
water and results in the creation of a
reservoir. Hence, ‘reservoir’ is the most
appropriate answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: Spending quality time with friends and family is also_____ to have a healthy daily routine. These happy moments release happy hormones in the body.
questions.explanation:
(a) obligatory
‘Obligatory’ means required to be done.
The given sentence states that spending
quality time with friends and family is
also obligatory to have a healthy daily
routine. Hence, ‘obligatory’ is the most
appropriate answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: _______, I'm going to walk my dog.
questions.explanation:
(c) Now
‘Now’ is used in present continuous
tense to indicate an activity that is
currently happening or going to happen.
Hence, ‘now’ is the most appropriate
answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: Select the most appropriate article(s) to fill in the blanks. I was in ______ state of unconsciousness for about half ________ hour.
questions.explanation:
(a) a ; an
Article ‘A’ is used before the words
starting with a consonant sound - (a
conversation, a story). Whereas, the
article ‘An’ is used before the words
starting with a vowel sound(an imminent
danger, an apple). In the given sentence,
‘state’ starts with a consonant sound and
‘hour’ starts with a vowel sound. Hence,
‘a ; an’ is the most appropriate answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: The rising rate of inflation is making life very hard for ________ poor.
questions.explanation:
(c) the
When article ‘the’ is used before an
adjective, it becomes a common noun
and refers to all those denoted by the
adjective. ‘The poor’ refers to all the
people who are poor. Hence, ‘the’ is the
most appropriate answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: He has not _______returned the money.
questions.explanation:
(a) yet
‘Yet’ is used in present perfect tense with
‘not’ to indicate that something has not
happened till this time. Similarly, in the
given sentence, the person has not
returned the money till this time. Hence,
‘yet’ is the most appropriate answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: It’s funny how every time he fails to apply the ______ and _______ the glass.
questions.explanation:
(c) brakes; breaks
‘Brakes’ are the components of a vehicle
used to stop it. ‘Break’ means to shatter
something into pieces. The given
sentence states that it’s funny how every
time he fails to apply that brakes and
breaks the glass. Hence, ‘brakes; breaks’
is the most appropriate answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: His family lives _______ Mahu in Madhya Pradesh.
questions.explanation:
(d) at
‘At’ is used to indicate a specific place
within a larger location. Similarly, ‘Mahu’
is a specific place in Madhya Pradesh.
Hence, ‘at’ is the most appropriate
answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: Accepting how wonderful you truly are and incorporating this _______ into your attitude and personality is perhaps one of the most difficult things to do in life.
questions.explanation:
(a) insight
‘Insight’ means an accurate and deep
understanding. The given sentence
states that accepting how wonderful you
truly are and incorporating this insight
into your attitude and personality is
perhaps one of the most difficult things
to do in life. Hence, ‘insight’ is the most
appropriate answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: Please put the dishes in the _______ after you finish eating.
questions.explanation:
(a) sink
‘Sink’ means a basin in a kitchen for
washing dishes. The given sentence
states a request to put the dishes in the
sink after you finish eating. Hence, ‘sink’
is the most appropriate answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: My grandparents live in a beautiful house _________the countryside.
questions.explanation:
(a) in
‘In’ is used for larger, more general
locations, such as cities, states,
countries, etc. ‘Countryside’ is a general
location, meaning the land and scenery
of a rural area. Hence, ‘in’ is the most
appropriate answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: In the following passage, some words have been deleted. Read the passage carefully and select the most appropriate option to fill in the blanks. Leif Erikson is a Viking ________ believed to have sailed from the Green Lands to Vinland. Vinland is now thought to be the northern tip of Canada's Newfoundland island where ________ found evidence of Erikson's ________ in 1960s.
questions.explanation:
(d) 
explorer; archaeologists; settlement
‘Explorer’ means someone who travels to
places about which very little is known.
‘Archaeologist’ is a scientist who studies
human history by digging up human
remains and artifacts. ‘Settlement’
means a place where people come to
live. The given sentence states that Leif
Erikson is a Viking explorer. Vinland is
now thought to be the northern tip of
Canada’s Newfoundland island where
archaeologists found evidence of
Erikson’s settlement in 1960s. Hence,
‘explorer; archaeologists; settlement’ is
the most appropriate answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: Select the most appropriate idiom/phrase to fill in the blank. My car __________ on the way to college yesterday.
questions.explanation:
(c) broke down
‘Broke down’ is the past form of the
phrasal verb ‘break down’, which means
to stop working. The given sentence
states that my car broke down on the
way to college yesterday. Hence, ‘broke
down’ is the most appropriate answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: The manager swiftly overtook him, _________effortlessly past the skinny Englishman, with a practiced ease.
questions.explanation:
(c) sliding
‘Sliding’ means moving smoothly and
effortlessly. The given sentence states
that the manager swiftly overtook him,
sliding effortlessly past the skinny
Englishman, with a practised ease.
Hence, ‘sliding’ is the most appropriate
answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: The charismatic leader's speeches were known for their ________ impact on motivating people to take positive actions.
questions.explanation:
(b) profound
‘Profound’ means very great or intense.
The given sentence states that the
charismatic leader’s speeches were
known for their profound impact on
motivating people to take positive
actions. Hence, ‘profound’ is the most
appropriate answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: The rising interest in and concern about animal welfare resulted in legislative laws and the formation of The Animal______Committee in many nations.
questions.explanation:
(b) Ethics
‘Ethics’ means moral principles that
govern a person's behaviour or the
conducting of an activity. The given
sentence states that the rising interest in
and concern about animal welfare
resulted in legislative laws and the
formation of The Animal Ethics
Committee in many nations. Hence,
‘ethics’ is the most appropriate answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: Select the most appropriate degree of comparison to fill in the blank. Work in this office is done in the _____ way.
questions.explanation:
(d) least efficient
Article ‘the’ is used before the superlative
degree. ‘Least efficient’ is the correct
superlative degree of ‘efficient’. Hence,
‘least efficient’ is the most appropriate
answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: The coaches decided to______ the regulations more strictly because the candidates were not paying attention during their training sessions.
questions.explanation:
(c) enforce
‘Enforce’ means to cause a law or rule to
be obeyed. The given sentence states
that the coaches decided to enforce the
regulations more strictly because the
candidates were not paying attention
during their training sessions. Hence,
‘enforce’ is the most appropriate answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: There was no one left in the world whom they could call _______.
questions.explanation:
(d) theirs
‘Theirs’ is a possessive pronoun used
with the pronoun ‘they’. ‘Their’ is a
possessive adjective used with a noun.
As there is no noun after the blank, we
can not use possessive adjective. Hence,
‘theirs’ is the most appropriate answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: I begin to pronounce the sequence of words and numbers that will prevent her from giving him a piece of her ______.
questions.explanation:
(a) mind
‘Give someone a piece of one’s mind’ is
an idiom which means to speak to
someone in an angry or critical way. The
given sentence states that I begin to
pronounce the sequence of words and
numbers that will prevent her from giving
him a piece of her mind. Hence, ‘mind’ is
the most appropriate answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: Due to______'eve teasing', parents conclude that it is not worth the danger of sending their daughters to school.
questions.explanation:
(d) widespread
‘Widespread’ means happening in many
places. The given passage states that
due to widespread ‘eve teasing’, parents
conclude that it is not worth the danger
of sending their daughters to school.
Hence, ‘widespread’ is the most
appropriate answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: I could _____ the reason for being _____.
questions.explanation:
(c) find; fined
‘Find’ means to discover something by
chance. ‘Fined’ means charged with an
amount of money as a punishment for
not obeying a rule or law. The given
sentence states that I could find the
reason for being fined. Hence, ‘find; fined’
is the most appropriate answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: She was a ______, ______, _______ astronaut.
questions.explanation:
(a) smart, tall, Indian
The correct order of adjectives is-
opinion, size, origin. ‘Smart’ is an
adjective expressing an opinion. ‘Tall’
indicates size. ‘Indian’ indicates origin.
Hence, ‘smart, tall, Indian’ is the most
appropriate answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: The writer's _____ prose resonated with readers, evoking powerful emotions.
questions.explanation:
(d) eloquent
‘Eloquent’ means giving a clear and
strong message. The given sentence
states that the writer’s eloquent prose
resonated with readers, evoking powerful
emotions. Hence, ‘eloquent’ is the most
appropriate answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: In the following passage, some words have been deleted. Read the passage carefully and select the most appropriate option to fill in the blanks. Michael Jackson is known as the King of Pop. He ________ his own genre of music, Pop. His music is spreading its influence and popularity ________ the world.
questions.explanation:
(a) dominates; around
‘Dominate’ means to be the most
important person or thing in a field. The
phrase ‘around the world’ means
everywhere in the world. The given
sentence states that Michael Jackson is
known as the King of Pop. He dominates
his own genre of music, Pop. His music
is spreading its influence and popularity
around the world. Hence, ‘dominates;
around’ is the most appropriate answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: He is going to _____ the campaign against excessive use of ________ in local production units.
questions.explanation:
(d) lead
‘Lead’ in the 1st blank means to guide in a
direction. ‘Lead’ in the 2nd blank means a
very heavy, soft, dark grey poisonous
substance. The given sentence states
that he is going to lead the campaign
against excessive use of lead in local
production units. Hence, ‘lead’ is the
most appropriate answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: Despite facing numerous challenges, the team successfully ______ the project ahead of schedule.
questions.explanation:
(c) completed
‘Completed’ is the correct verb to use
here, indicating simple past tense.
‘Successfully’ is an adverb which
modifies the verb completed. Hence,
‘completed’ is the most appropriate
answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: The assignment was ______ early in the morning.
questions.explanation:
(d) due
‘Due’ means expected at a certain time.
The given sentence states that the
assignment was due early in the
morning. Hence, ‘due’ is the most
appropriate answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: The teacher asked the students to remain ____, but the noise continued to ____. She finally had to raise her voice to gain control.
questions.explanation:
(c) quiet; rise
‘Quiet’ means not making any noise or
disturbance. ‘Rise’ means to increase in
amount or level. The given sentence
states that the teacher asked the
students to remain quiet, but the noise
continued to rise. She finally had to raise
her voice to gain control. Hence, ‘quiet;
rise’ is the most appropriate answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: With the increasing reliance on digital systems, ensuring robust cybersecurity measures is ____ to protect against online threats.
questions.explanation:
(d) paramount
‘Paramount’ means more important than
anything else. The given sentence states
that with the increasing reliance on
digital systems, ensuring robust
cybersecurity measures is paramount to
protect against online threats. Hence,
‘paramount’ is the most appropriate
answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: Vinod had a ____escape in the car accident
questions.explanation:
(c) narrow
The phrase ‘narrow escape’ means a
situation in which an accident or other
unfortunate incident is only just avoided.
The given sentence states that Vinod had
a narrow escape in the car accident.
Hence, 'narrow' is the most appropriate
answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: The group of travellers were wonderstruck by the ________ of the coin.
questions.explanation:
(d) weight
The given sentence states that the group
of travellers were wonderstruck by the
weight of the coin. Hence, ‘weight’ is the
most appropriate answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: Two of the fugitives managed to remain free by adeptly avoiding the _________ of the police.
questions.explanation:
(c) pursuit
‘Pursuit’ means the act of following
someone to try to catch him. The given
sentence states that two of the fugitives
managed to remain free by adeptly
avoiding the pursuit of the police. Hence,
‘pursuit’ is the most appropriate answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: We have postponed this movie outing too many times, so we are going tomorrow, come _____ or shine.
questions.explanation:
(a) rain
The given sentence states that we have
postponed this movie outing too many
times, so we are going tomorrow, come
rain or shine. Hence, ‘rain’ is the most
appropriate answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: He had _____ the ______ into smaller clips.
questions.explanation:
(d) clipped, clipping
‘Clipped’ means cut short neatly &
‘clipping’ means an article cut from a
newspaper or magazine. The given
sentence states that he had clipped the
clipping into smaller clips. Hence,
‘clipped, clipping’ is the most appropriate
answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: After years of fights with his neighbour Ram, Shekhar decided to hold out the _______ and invited Ram for tea.
questions.explanation:
(d) olive branch
‘Olive branch’ is an idiom which means
an offer or gesture of conciliation or
goodwill. The given sentence states that
after years of fights with his neighbour
Ram, Shekhar decided to hold out the
olive branch and invited Ram for tea.
Hence, ‘olive branch’ is the most
appropriate answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: To ______ the ticket, Amith had to visit the travel agency many times.
questions.explanation:
(b) confirm
‘Confirm’ means to be sure of something.
The given sentence states that to
confirm the ticket, Amith had to visit the
travel agency many times. Hence,
‘confirm’ is the most appropriate answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: Kamal is not willing to purchase a house on the 12th floor of a sea-side apartment, as she is fearful of heights. She is suffering from ___________.
questions.explanation:
(d) acrophobia
‘Acrophobia’ is an irrational fear of
heights. The given sentence states that
Kamal is not willing to purchase a house
on the 12th floor of a sea-side apartment,
as she is fearful of heights and she is
suffering from acrophobia. Hence,
‘acrophobia’ is the most appropriate
answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: Ram went to _____ an ice cream.
questions.explanation:
(a) buy
The given sentence states that Ram went
to buy an ice cream. Hence, ‘buy’ is the
most appropriate answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: Select the most appropriate verb / verb phrase to fill in the blank. They _______ their house for the past two months, and it’s finally starting to look fantastic.
questions.explanation:
(d) have been renovating
Perfect continuous tense is used with
‘for/since’ indicating the period of time.
‘Plural subject (they) + have been + V ’
ing
is the correct grammatical structure of
present perfect continuous tense. Hence,
‘have been renovating’ is the most
appropriate answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: The US ________ building was built in the year 1800.
questions.explanation:
(d) capitol
‘Capitol’ means the building in which the
US Congress meets. The given sentence
states that the US capitol building was
built in the year 1800. Hence, 'capitol' is
the most appropriate answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: Sharat is always __________ about showing up for work because he believes that tardiness gets us nowhere.
questions.explanation:
(d) punctual
‘Punctual’ means doing something at the
agreed or proper time. The given
sentence states that Sharat is always
punctual about showing up for work
because he believes that tardiness gets
us nowhere. Hence, 'punctual' is the most
appropriate answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: Raj is very interested in studying human psychology, so he decided to pursue his master’s degree in __________.
questions.explanation:
(c) Psychology
The given sentence talks about the
interest of Raj in studying human
psychology. Hence, ‘psychology’ is the
most appropriate answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: The mother couldn’t ______ such an insult from her son in front of the others.
questions.explanation:
(d) bear
‘Bear’ means to tolerate or accept
something. The given sentence states
that the mother couldn’t bear such an
insult from her son in front of the others.
Hence, ‘bear’ is the most appropriate
answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: Select the most appropriate verb / verb phrase to fill in the blank. Akshaya __________ hard for the entrance exam and received a high score.
questions.explanation:
(d) studied
The given sentence is in the past tense,
so it must have the verb in the past
form(V 2). Hence, ‘studied(V 2)’ is the most
appropriate answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: I like bread made up of corn _____.
questions.explanation:
(b) flour
‘Flour’ means powdered grain, especially
of wheat. The given sentence states that
I like bread made up of corn. Hence,
‘flour’ is the most appropriate answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: Select the most appropriate verb / verb phrase to fill in the blank. The team ____________ the championship before their star player got injured.
questions.explanation:
(b) had won
If two actions took place in the past then
the 1st action must be in the Past perfect
tense(Had + V3) and the 2nd action must
be in the Simple Past tense (V2). The
first action is winning the championship.
Hence, ‘had won (V3)’ is the most
appropriate answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: Yesterday, I ate only a ____ of apples for my dinner.
questions.explanation:
(b) pair
‘Pair’ means a set of two things. The
given sentence states that yesterday, I
ate only a pair of apples for my dinner.
Hence ‘pair’ is the most appropriate
answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: In both countries we have leaders of_____ ability.
questions.explanation:
(a) exceptional
‘Exceptional’ means much greater or
better than usual. The given sentence
states that we have leaders of
exceptional ability in both countries.
Hence ‘exceptional’ is the most
appropriate answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: It took 4 hours straight to _____the deal with the regional company.
questions.explanation:
(c) close
‘Close’ is the correct verb to use with
‘deal’. ‘Closing the deal’ means to make a
successful business arrangement with
someone. Hence, ‘close’ is the most
appropriate answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: Select the most appropriate option that can best replace the bracketed word to fill in the blank. His ________ stature was not a measure of his overall personality. (scrawny)
questions.explanation:
(a) thin
‘Scrawny’ means unattractively thin and
bony. The given sentence states that his
thin stature was not a measure of his
overall personality. Hence, ‘thin’ is the
most appropriate answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: Select the most appropriate homonym to fill in the blank. ________is a red-coloured root vegetable.
questions.explanation:
(b) Beet - a round, dark red
vegetable that grows in the ground and is
usually cooked and eaten cold

states that we must try and incorporate
positive thinking in our lives to derive
countless benefits it has to offer. Hence,
‘derive’ is the most appropriate answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: Select the most appropriate article to fill in the blank. Ratan doesn’t like _________ tea.
questions.explanation:
(b) No article required
‘Tea’ is an uncountable noun and we
generally do not use any article before
uncountable nouns. Hence, ‘no article
required’ is the most appropriate answer.
Questions (420 to 501) (Correct)

questions.prompt: Select the correct form of the past tense to fill in the blank. I _______ a headache earlier, but I feel fine now.
questions.explanation:
(b) had
The use of the word ‘earlier’ indicates
past tense. ‘Have’ is a stative verb which
is generally not written in continuous
tense. Therefore, the past form ‘had’ will
be used to indicate the simple past
tense. Hence, ‘had’ is the most
appropriate answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: Select the most appropriate article to fill in the blank. Your shirt is ______ same colour as mine.
questions.explanation:
(d) the
Article ‘the’ is used before the word
‘same’ if there is a noun after it. In the
given sentence, there is a noun ‘colour’
after the word ‘same’. Hence, ‘the’ is the
most appropriate answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: It is a proven fact that _______ living being can survive without water.
questions.explanation:
(b) no
‘No’ as an adjective means ‘not a single’.
Similarly, in the given sentence, ‘no’ has
been used as an adjective. The given
sentence states that not a single living
being can survive without water. Hence,
‘no’ is the most appropriate answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: The smoke coming out of the factory chimneys was polluting the air, which was becoming a major _________ for the local residents.
questions.explanation:
(d) concern
‘Concern’ means a matter of interest or
importance to someone. The given
sentence states that the smoke coming
out of the factory chimneys was polluting
the air, which was becoming a major
concern for the local residents. Hence,
‘concern’ is the most appropriate answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: A popular theory among critics is that the character Count Dracula is based on the ________ barbaric Vlad III, better known as Vlad the Impaler.
questions.explanation:
(a) infamously
‘Infamously’ means well known for some
bad quality. The given sentence states
that a popular theory among critics is
that the character Count Dracula is
based on the infamously barbaric Vlad III,
better known as Vlad the Impaler. Hence,
‘infamously’ is the most appropriate
answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: We met a lot of people _______ our stay in Ahmedabad.
questions.explanation:
(a) during
‘During’ is used to indicate the event or
occasion when something happened.
Similarly, in the given sentence, ‘during’
has been used to indicate the time when
we met a lot of people. Hence, ‘during’ is
the most appropriate answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: Shraddha wandered through the labyrinth of thoughts, seeking clarity ______ chaos.
questions.explanation:
(d) amidst
‘Amidst’ means in the middle of
something. The given sentence states
that Shraddha wandered through the
labyrinth of thoughts, seeking clarity
amidst chaos. Hence, ‘amidst’ is the
most appropriate answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: One answer to the _______ of air pollution is to build a car that does not pollute.
questions.explanation:
(a) problem
The given sentence states that one
answer to the problem of air pollution is
to build a car that does not pollute.
Hence, ‘problem’ is the most appropriate
answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: Neither of the biscuits you gave me _________ chocolate chips.
questions.explanation:
(d) contains
‘Everyone/each/ every/ nothing/
everything/ anything/ either/ neither’
represents a singular noun. Therefore, a
singular verb (contains) will be used with
them. Hence, ‘contains’ is the most
appropriate answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: Stanley ______ to play the violin now, with an amateur instructor.
questions.explanation:
(a) is learning
‘Is/am/are + V-ing’ is grammatically the
correct structure for the given sentence
which is in the present continuous tense.
Hence, ‘is learning(V-ing)’ is the most
appropriate answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: Mohnish and Ravi _______ to Canada next month.
questions.explanation:
(a) are moving
Present Continuous tense is used for
events planned for the near future. Here,
Mohnish and Ravi have planned to move
to Canada next month. ‘Plural subject +
are + V ing’ is the correct grammatical
structure for present continuous tense.
Hence, ‘are moving’ is the most
appropriate answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: Currently, Mittu and Bittu ________ hard to meet the project deadline.
questions.explanation:
(b) are working
‘Is/am/are + V-ing’ is grammatically the
correct structure for the given sentence
which is in the present continuous tense.
Also, according to the “Subject-Verb
Agreement Rule”, a plural subject(Mittu
and Bittu) always takes a plural verb(are).
Hence, ‘are working(V-ing)’ is the most
appropriate answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: The teacher asked the students to _______ their ideas during the class discussion.
questions.explanation:
(c) bring up
The phrasal verb ‘ bring up’ means to
start to talk about a particular subject.
The given sentence states that the
teacher asked the students to present
their ideas during the class discussion.
Hence, ‘bring up’ is the most appropriate
answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: The war _______ badly damaged the country’s infrastructure.
questions.explanation:
(a) has
‘Singular Subject(war) + has + V 3 ’ is
grammatically the correct structure for
the given sentence which is in the
present perfect tense. Hence, ‘has’ is the
most appropriate answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: The teacher asked the students to ______their essays before the deadline.
questions.explanation:
(c) hand in
The phrasal verb ‘ hand in’ means to
submit. The given sentence states that
the teacher asked the students to submit
their essays before the deadline. Hence,
‘hand in’ is the most appropriate answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: The small coffee shop at the end of the road is____________.
questions.explanation:
(c) mine
When possessive is written separate
from the noun, we use pronouns such as
mine, his, hers, yours, etc. In the given
sentence, the possessive is written
separate from its noun (coffee shop).
Hence, ‘mine’ is the most appropriate
answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: Gautam ______ all the documents by the time his senior advocate reached the court.
questions.explanation:
(b) had examined
If two actions took place in the past then
the 1st action must be in the Past perfect
tense(Had + V 3 ) and the 2nd action must
be in the Simple Past tense(V 2 ). Hence,
‘had examined(V 3 )’ is the most
appropriate answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: She was so busy ______writing that when the maid came ______she didn’t hear her.
questions.explanation:
(a) in, in
In the first blank, ‘in’ is used after ‘busy’
to indicate the activity in which someone
is engaged. And in the second blank, ‘in’
has been used to show the presence of a
maid inside a room or house. Hence, ‘in,
in’ is the most appropriate answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: Hurry up ! There’s still ________ work left to do.
questions.explanation:
(b) much
We use ‘much’ before uncountable nouns
like much money(uncountable), much
milk, etc. Similarly, ‘work’ in the given
sentence is an uncountable noun. Hence,
‘much’ is the most appropriate answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: He gazed around the room ______ lay hidden a treasure chest.
questions.explanation:
(c) wherein
‘Wherein’ is used to indicate a location or
a situation in which something is located
or occurs. The given sentence states that
he gazed around the room in which a
treasure chest was hidden. Hence,
‘wherein’ is the most appropriate answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: Each one of the participants in the annual function ________ an applause.
questions.explanation:
(b) deserves
‘Deserve’ means to be worthy of
something. The given sentence states
that each one of the participants in the
annual function is worthy of an applause.
Hence, ‘deserves’ is the most appropriate
answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: The air quality is so bad ______it becomes difficult to breathe.
questions.explanation:
(c) that
‘So…that’ is a fixed conjunction pair.
Hence, ‘that’ is the most appropriate
answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: If I go to Bangalore, I ______ with my nephew.
questions.explanation:
(b) will stay
The given sentence is an example of the
first conditional sentence and the correct
grammatical structure is “if + simple
present…….will +V 1 ”. Hence, ‘will stay(V 1 )’
is the most appropriate answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: I trust him completely. His conduct is ________ suspicion.
questions.explanation:
(c) above
The phrase ‘above/beyond suspicion’ is
used when there is no doubt about the
honesty of a person. Hence, ‘above’ is the
most appropriate answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: By this time tomorrow, I _______ the work assigned to me.
questions.explanation:
(c) I will have done
Future perfect tense is used when the
time of completion is a point of time in
the future, such as ‘by the time, by this
time’. In the given sentence, the deadline
has been given(by this time tomorrow),
which is a future point of time. Hence, ‘I
will have’ is the most appropriate answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: _________ that thought. It will be a great idea someday.
questions.explanation:
(a) Hold onto
The phrasal verb ‘hold onto’ means to
keep something that is important or
useful. The given sentence states a
suggestion that the person should keep
that thought. It will be a great idea
someday. Hence, ‘hold onto’ is the most
appropriate answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: Robin watched as the smoke _______ steadily from the chimney.
questions.explanation:
(b) rose
‘Rose’ means to go up in the direction of
the sky. The given sentence states that
Robin watched as the smoke rose
steadily from the chimney. Hence, ‘rose’
is the most appropriate answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: The girl was ________ as she was drenched in the rain.
questions.explanation:
(c) cold
‘Cold’ means at a lower temperature than
normal. The given sentence states that
the girl was cold as she was drenched in
the rain. Hence, ‘cold’ is the most
appropriate answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: You use an ______ to steer a boat.
questions.explanation:
(c) Oar
‘Oar’ is a pole with a flat blade used to
steer or row a boat. The given sentence
states that you use an oar to steer a
boat. Hence, ‘oar’ is the most appropriate
answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: Arunima ________ a lot during her vacation time.
questions.explanation:
(b) gets about
The phrasal verb ‘get about’ means to go
to different places. The given sentence
states that Arunima gets about a lot
during her vacation time. Hence, ‘gets
about’ is the most appropriate answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: Though Pradeep ____for Jamaica, he landed up in Nigeria.
questions.explanation:
(a) set out
The phrasal verb ‘set out’ means to begin
a journey. The given sentence states that
though Pradeep set out for Jamaica, he
landed up in Nigeria. Hence, ‘set out’ is
the most appropriate answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: The company had some initial problems, but now it is ___________
questions.explanation:
(d) Flying high - is very
successful. (Correct)

questions.prompt: They knew that the stock of the food was getting reduced and the fund _________ for that was not enough for the next week.
questions.explanation:
(a) allotted
‘Allot’ means to give a share of
something to someone. The given
sentence states that they knew that the
stock of the food was getting reduced
and the fund allotted for that was not
enough for the next week. Hence,
‘alloted’ is the most appropriate answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: Being courteous ______ costs you nothing.
questions.explanation: (a) No article required. (Correct)

questions.prompt: It took seven years for Harish to __________ his migraine.
questions.explanation:
(a) Shake off
‘Shake off’ means to successfully deal
with or recover from an illness, injury, or
negative feeling. The given sentence
states that it took seven years for Harish
to recover from his migraine. Hence,
‘shake off’ is the most appropriate
answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: Hardik Pandya hit four ________ fours and scored 72 runs in the match.
questions.explanation:
(b) consecutive
‘Consecutive’ means happening one after
the other without interruption. The given
sentence states that Hardik Pandya hit
four consecutive fours and scored 72
runs in the match. Hence, ‘consecutive’ is
the most appropriate answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: The hiring manager has already offered you the job; now, ______ to accept or decline the offer.
options: the ball is in your court
questions.explanation:
(b) The ball is in the court - it is
up to you to make the next move. (Correct)

questions.prompt: Ours is _______ house of all the houses in our area.
questions.explanation:
(b) the biggest
We generally use superlative degree with
the definite article ‘the’ and ‘the biggest’
is the correct superlative degree
adjective. Hence, ‘the biggest’ is the
most appropriate answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: Early childhood experiences have a ________ impact on brain development affecting learning, health, behaviour, and, ultimately, productivity and income.
questions.explanation:
(b) profound
‘Profound’ means deep or intense. The
given sentence states that the
experiences that children have in their
early years can have a deep impact on
the way their brains develop. Hence,
‘profound’ is the most appropriate
answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: The students of class 7 gave their teacher a gift, which was ________to her.
questions.explanation:
(d) surprising
‘Surprising’ means causing astonishment
or unexpectedness. The given sentence
states that class 7 students gave their
teacher a gift, which was unexpected or
astonishing to the teacher. Hence,
‘surprising’ is the most appropriate
answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: He is _________ of many chain snatching cases in Dariyaganj.
questions.explanation:
(d) accused
‘Accused’ is the correct spelling. (Correct)

questions.prompt: Her stories paid ________ to her mother, whom she regarded as the goddess of bravery.
questions.explanation:
(d) homage
‘Homage’ means deep respect and praise
shown for a person or god. The given
sentence states that her stories showed
deep respect and praise to her mother,
whom she considered a symbol of
bravery and excellence. Hence, ‘homage’
is the most appropriate answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: Suresh has been learning Tami _________ two months.
questions.explanation:
(d) for
‘For’ is used for a fixed period of
time(countable) like 2 years/3 months/4
days/8 hours and for an activity that
happened in a recent time. Hence, ‘for’ is
the most appropriate answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: Can you quote any_______ in your favour?
questions.explanation:
(d) precedent
‘Precedent’ means a legal decision that
supports a position or argument. The
given sentence states a question to
enquire about any precedent in his
favour. Hence, ‘precedent’ is the most
appropriate answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: Bhanu, the security guard, asks everyone entering my building to show their ______ card.
questions.explanation:
(a) identity
An identity card means a person’s
information to prove who he is. The given
sentence states that the security guard
checks for identity cards from all
entering the building as a security
measure. Hence, ‘identity’ is the most
appropriate answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: The tone of his voice seemed to ______ that he knew more than he was letting on.
questions.explanation:
(d) imply
‘Imply’ means to suggest something
without saying it directly. The given
sentence states that the tone of his voice
seemed to suggest that he knew more
than he was revealing. Hence, ‘imply’ is
the most appropriate answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: COVID-19 _________structural weaknesses in health systems worldwide and negatively impacted individuals, societies, and economies.
questions.explanation:
(d) revealed
‘Reveal’ means to expose something that
was hidden or not known. The given
sentence states that COVID-19 revealed
structural weaknesses in health systems
worldwide. Hence, ‘revealed’ is the most
appropriate answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: Varun has to _________ his studies for the sake of his ill father.
questions.explanation:
(a) sacrifice
‘Sacrifice’ means to give up something
valuable in order to help someone. The
given sentence states that Varun has to
give up his studies for the sake of his ill
father. Hence, ‘sacrifice’ is the most
appropriate answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: Some things are meant to be, and death is _______ for humans.
questions.explanation:
(c) natural
‘Natural’ means something common or is
expected. The given sentence states that
death is a natural part of the human
experience. Hence, ‘natural’ is the most
appropriate answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: Most times, he is sitting alone, immersed in his own ________ .
questions.explanation:
(b) monologue
‘Monologue’ means a long conversation
by one person, typically one’s thoughts.
The given sentence states that he is
sitting alone and is lost in his own
thoughts. Hence, ‘monologue’ is the
most appropriate answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: They are going to give me a lovely present, but I cannot _____ what it will be.
questions.explanation:
(c) guess
‘Guess’ means to estimate or think about
something without having its proper
information. The given sentence states
that they are going to give me a lovely
present, but I cannot guess what it will
be. Hence, ‘guess’ is the most
appropriate answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: The mother ________ the chips because they were soggy.
questions.explanation:
(c) discarded
‘Discarded’ means to get rid of
something or throw it away. The given
sentence states that the mother
discarded the chips because they were
soggy. Hence, ‘discarded’ is the most
appropriate answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: During the meeting, he went on a long and angry _______ about how the project was being mismanaged.
questions.explanation:
(c) rant
‘Rant’ means when someone speaks at
length in an angry way. The given
sentence states that during the meeting,
he went on a long and angry rant about
how the project was being mismanaged.
Hence, ‘rant’ is the most appropriate
answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: Chaitnya was _______ from the school due to his misappropriate behaviour.
questions.explanation:
(a) expelled
‘Expelled’ is the correct spelling. (Correct)

questions.prompt: Ministry of education has announced that students can ________ the Board Examinations twice.
questions.explanation:
(a) Take
‘Take’ is commonly used when referring
to students participating in or attempting
exams. The given sentence states that
the Ministry of education has announced
that students can take the Board
Examinations twice. Hence, ‘take’ is the
most appropriate answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: All praised him when he soared in the business world, but the same people ______ him when he failed in business.
questions.explanation:
(b) Criticised
‘Criticised’ means finding fault. The given
sentence states that All praised him
when he soared in the business world,
but the same people criticised him when
he failed in business. Hence, ‘criticised’ is
the most appropriate answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: Augmented Reality (AR) continues to develop and become more _______ among a wide range of applications.
questions.explanation:
(d) pervasive
‘Pervasive’ means spreading widely
throughout an area or group. The given
sentence states that Augmented Reality
(AR) continues to develop and become
more pervasive among a wide range of
applications. Hence, ‘pervasive’ is the
most appropriate answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: A/An _________ fellow cannot become an ideal teacher.
questions.explanation:
(a) idle
‘Idle’ means being inactive, not engaged
in work or activities. The given sentence
states that a person who is lazy or
inactive cannot become an ideal teacher.
Hence, ‘idle’ is the most appropriate
answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: Virtual worlds are recently new phenomena in that they _________ people to meet and socially interact with others in a variety of online environments.
questions.explanation:
(d) enable
‘Enable’ means give (someone) the
authority or means to do something. The
given sentence states that virtual worlds
are recently new phenomena in that they
enable people to meet and socially
interact with others in a variety of online
environments. Hence, ‘enable’ is the
most appropriate answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: He is a smug and very ______ person who thinks only about himself.
questions.explanation:
(c) egoistic
Egoistic means someone excessively
self-centered. The given sentence states
that he is a smug and very egoistic
person who thinks only about himself.
Hence, ‘egoistic’ is the most appropriate
answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: I know that I can count on my best friend to be by my side through ______ and thin.
questions.explanation:
(c) thick
The idiom ‘through thick and thin’ means
to persevere through good times as well
as bad. The given sentence states that I
know that I can count on my best friend
to be by my side through thick and thin.
Hence, ‘thick and thin’ is the most
appropriate answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: Make-up was ___ she hardly wore.
questions.explanation:
(b) something
‘Something’ is used when the specific
thing (in this sentence, make-up) being
referred to is not known in detail. Hence,
‘something’ is the most appropriate
answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: Ravi has little in ______ with his friend, Senthil.
questions.explanation:
(a) common
The phrase ‘in common’ is used to
indicate similarity or shared interests.
The given sentence states that Ravi has
little in common with his friend, Senthil.
Hence, ‘common’ is the most appropriate
answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: The toddler decided to make a mess because he wanted to______the attention of its parents.
questions.explanation:
(a) seek
‘Seek’ means to try to get something. The
given sentence states that the toddler
intentionally created a mess because he
wanted to get the attention of its parents.
Hence, ‘seek’ is the most appropriate
answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: The teacher assured: "You have completed your homework, ________?”
questions.explanation:
(c) haven't you
According to the “Question Tag rule”, if
the statement is positive, the question
tag will be negative & Vice-versa.
However, the sentence and the question
tag must be in the same tense. Similarly,
the given sentence is positive so the
question tag will be negative(haven’t).
Hence, ‘haven't you’ is the most
appropriate answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: A strong __________ for mathematics and problem-solving can be very useful.
questions.explanation:
(b) aptitude
‘Aptitude’ means a natural ability to do
something. The given sentence states
that a strong aptitude for mathematics
and problem-solving can be very useful.
Hence, ‘aptitude’ is the most appropriate
answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: Select the most appropriate response in the given situation of the eve of a battle to fill in the blank. The commander: "Honourable Emperor, all the troops have lined up for the battle and are awaiting your orders." Emperor Chandragupta Maurya: ‘’_________’’
options: You should learn how to talk to an emperor.
We are ready for the pilgrimage.
questions.explanation:
(a) We will march at dawn.
"We will march at dawn" is the most
appropriate response as it acknowledges
the readiness of the troops and indicates
the emperor's decision to commence the
battle early in the morning. Hence, ‘we
will march at dawn’ is the most
appropriate answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: I wish we had _______ come here.
questions.explanation:
(c) never
The given sentence needs an adverb
here to modify the verb ‘come’. Hence,
‘never’ is the most appropriate answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: Winning the championship was a dream come true for the team, but being awarded the MVP trophy was __________ .
questions.explanation:
(d) The icing on the cake-
something that makes a good situation
even better. (Correct)

questions.prompt: The scratches on her hands were clear signs of domestic violence,______ and said that she got scratched by barbed wire fencing.
questions.explanation:
(b) yet she lied
The given sentence states that there
were visible scratches on her hands
indicating domestic violence, yet she lied
and said that she got scratched by
barbed wire fencing. Hence, ‘yet she lied’
is the most appropriate answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: The chief guest is ________ to arrive at the venue within half an hour.
questions.explanation:
(c) expected
‘Expected’ means likely to happen. The
given sentence states that the chief
guest is likely to arrive at the venue
within half an hour. Hence, ‘expected’ is
the most appropriate answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: The chef's culinary creations were infused with a distinctive _______ that set them apart from typical restaurant fare.
questions.explanation:
(d) flair
‘Flair’ means someone's natural talent for
something. The given sentence states
that the chef's dishes had a unique style
that set them apart from typical
restaurant food. Hence, ‘flair’ is the most
appropriate answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: The_______ of the crime scene made it difficult for investigators to gather evidence.
questions.explanation:
(d) site
‘Site’ means the piece of land where
something is located. The given
sentence states that the site of the crime
scene made it difficult for investigators
to gather evidence. Hence, ‘site’ is the
most appropriate answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: I can't _______ this heat anymore.
questions.explanation:
(c) bear
‘Bear’ means to tolerate or endure
something. The given sentence states
that I am no longer able to tolerate the
heat. Hence, ‘bear’ is the most
appropriate answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: My cousin owns a shop of food_________.
questions.explanation:
(a) additives
‘Additives’ means a substance added to
something in small quantities to improve
or preserve it. The given sentence states
that my cousin owns a shop of food
additives. Hence, ‘additives’ is the most
appropriate answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: She suffered an emotional ___________ after the death of her husband in a road accident.
questions.explanation:
(d) turbulence
‘Turbulence’ means a state of disorder,
confusion, or instability in various
situations. The given sentence states
that she suffered an emotional
turbulence after the death of her
husband in a road accident. Hence,
‘turbulence’ is the most appropriate
answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: The______of the new legislation has sparked a heated debate among lawmakers.
questions.explanation:
(c) effect
‘Effect’ means a change which is a result
or consequence of an action or other
cause. The given sentence states that
the effect of the new legislation has led
to a heated debate among lawmakers.
Hence, ‘effect’ is the most appropriate
answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: People were_____ to safe places by the rescue team after the earthquake.
questions.explanation:
(b) evacuated
‘Evacuated’ means the act of moving
people or objects out of a place of
danger or emergency to a safer location.
The given sentence states that people
were evacuated to safe places by the
rescue team after the earthquake. Hence,
‘evacuated’ is the most appropriate
answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: The_______ age for retirement is 65 years in India.
questions.explanation:
(d) mandatory
‘Mandatory’ is the correct spelling. (Correct)

questions.prompt: The CEO's ____________ disregard for his employees' well-being led to high turnover and low morale in the company.
questions.explanation:
(c) callous
‘Callous’ means having a cruel and
insensitive disregard for others. The
given sentence states that the CEO’s
insensitive disregard for his employee’s
well-being led to higher profits and lower
morale in the company. Hence, ‘callous’
is the most appropriate answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: Sarah just gave ______ to a baby boy.
questions.explanation:
(a) birth
‘GIve birth’ means to produce a baby
from your body. The given sentence
states that Sarah just gave birth to a
baby boy. Hence, ‘birth’ is the most
appropriate answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: The _______ of the company's CEO was widely praised for her innovative leadership.
questions.explanation:
(d) reign
‘Reign’ means the period during which
somebody is in charge of an
organisation. The given sentence states
that the CEO was praised for her
innovative leadership during the time she
was in charge of the company. Hence,
‘reign’ is the most appropriate answer.
Questions (502 to 582) (Correct)

questions.prompt: She is _____ a peacock in the blue satin saree
questions.explanation:

questions.prompt: I am sorry that I was unable to see _______ of you over the summer.

questions.prompt: John rushed to the spot and saw his wife and kid __________ on the road.

questions.prompt: Today I received a letter. Finally, I _____ back from him.
questions.explanation:

questions.prompt: Women ___________ their male relatives to the battlefield for the purpose of tending the wounded and carrying away the dead.

questions.prompt: The most common sports injury is a _______.

temperatures can soar in summer,

breathable. Hence, ‘Breathable’ is the

questions.prompt: This ____ piece of mischief by his brother brought a quiet laugh from David.

in a way that might be funny or
annoying.The given sentence states that
this whimsical piece of mischief by his
brother brought a quiet laugh from David.
Hence, ‘Whimsical’ is the most
appropriate answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: For months, Drupad could not taste anything he ate as regret layered ________ mud.

a comparison between two things - the
layering of regret and the feeling or state
of Drupad's mouth. Hence, ‘his mouth

questions.prompt: During treatment, patients lay ______on the treatment couch for around 3 hrs.
questions.explanation:
(d) Supine
‘Supine’ means a person lying face
upward. The given sentence states that
during treatment, patients lay supine on

Hence, ‘Supine’ is the most appropriate
answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: If the anesthesia is not _________ properly, he might wake up in the _______ of the surgery .
questions.explanation:

‘Administered’ means to control the
situation, operation or arrangement of
something. The given sentence states
that If the anesthesia is not administered

‘administered/middle’ is the most
appropriate answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: Societies need to develop highly ______behavioural rules for survival.
questions.explanation:

‘Adaptive’ means having an ability to
change to suit changing conditions.The

behavioural rules for survival. Hence,

questions.prompt: The man who is supposed to be protecting them is somehow their fiercest and most ______ enemy.
questions.explanation:

questions.prompt: Before about 1830, ____ sermons, tracts and addresses routinely broached female intemperance.

‘Temperance’ means moderation in

intemperance. Hence,‘Temperance’ is the
most appropriate answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: According to the politician, using vulgar language to_______votes is not something he will endorse.
questions.explanation:

‘Garner’ means to gather or collect. The
given sentence states that according to

endorse. Hence, ‘Garner’ is the most

questions.prompt: I was really hoping to______ a decent movie this time, and I came up with an undisputed classic.
questions.explanation:

Hence, ‘unearth’ is the most appropriate

questions.prompt: The pudding fell ________ floor with a heart-stopping crash.
questions.explanation:

The phrase ‘To the’ is generally used to

questions.prompt: The sedative effect of the drugs impairs people's ability to pay attention and_______.
questions.explanation:
(a) Concentrate
‘Concentrate’ means to focus all one's
attention on a particular object or
activity. The given sentence states that
the sedative effect of the drugs impairs
people's ability to pay attention and
concentrate. Hence, ‘Concentrate’ is the
most appropriate answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: She kept pictures of her parents all_________ the house.
questions.explanation:
(b) Over
The phrase ‘All over’ means everywhere.
The given sentence states that she kept
pictures of her parents all over the
house. Hence, ‘Over’ is the most
appropriate answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: At gurukul they spend many years together, growing into the best of friends, and was time for each to return to his home, they wept.
questions.explanation:
(c) When it
‘When’ functions as a subordinating
conjunction. As a subordinating
conjunction, ‘when’ introduces a
dependent clause that provides
additional information about the timing
or condition of the main clause. It
establishes a relationship between the
two clauses. Hence, ‘When it’ is the most
appropriate answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: The television is big, has an excellent picture, and last but not , it's cheap.
questions.explanation:
(d) least
The phrase "last but not least" is a
commonly used expression indicating
that something is mentioned as the final
item on a list, but it is not less important
than the previous ones. Hence, ‘least’ is
the most appropriate answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: Obesity is also a progressive condition, unlike anorexia nervosa, which tends to ______ with age.
questions.explanation:
(b) Ameliorate
‘Ameliorate’ means to improve or make
something better. The given sentence
states that Obesity is also a progressive
condition, unlike anorexia nervosa, which
tends to ameliorate with age. Hence,
‘ameliorate’ is the most appropriate
answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: Sitting at the computer I saw something large and dark fall past my ______ vision followed by a dull thwack.
questions.explanation:
(c) Peripheral
'Peripheral' refers to something that is
situated at the edge or boundary of
something. The given sentence states
that Sitting at the computer I saw
something large and dark fall past my
peripheral vision followed by a dull
thwack. Hence, ‘peripheral’ is the most
appropriate answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: In my view, this falls within the exception permitting warrantless seizure in ________ circumstances.
questions.explanation:
(d) Exigent
‘Exigent’ means pressing, urgent, or
requiring immediate action or attention.
The given sentence states that In my
view, this falls within the exception
permitting warrantless seizure in exigent
circumstances. Hence, ‘exigent’ is the
most appropriate answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: The question is why an ________ Hollywood film should provoke such a hostile reaction.
questions.explanation:
(b) innocuous
‘Innocuous’ means not meant to cause
harm or upset somebody. The given
sentence states that the question is why
an innocuous Hollywood film should
provoke such a hostile reaction. Hence,
‘innocuous’ is the most appropriate
answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: Fetal ________screening uses ultrasound scanning to find certain abnormalities in the baby.
questions.explanation:
(b) anomaly
‘Anomaly’ means deviation from the
normal or common form. The given

screening uses ultrasound scanning to
find certain abnormalities in the baby.

answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: For years, people afflicted with the itchy skin condition used stinky coal tar derivatives to ______their symptoms.

‘Alleviate’ means to make something less

‘alleviate’ is the most appropriate answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: This initiative has been sharply criticised as grossly inefficient and ____.
questions.explanation:
(b) Counterproductive
"Counterproductive" means that it is not
achieving the desired results and is
actually hindering progress or success.

initiative has been sharply criticised as
grossly inefficient and counterproductive.
Hence, ‘counterproductive’ is the most
appropriate answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: We cannot _______ a religion or a political party that ignores the rights of half the human race.
questions.explanation:

party that ignores the rights of half the
human race. Hence, ‘Forgive’ is the most
appropriate answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: The duke had capacity, but his life was so _______ that what influence he had upon the king was for evil.
questions.explanation:
(c) Lewd
‘Lewd’ means obscene, vulgar. The given

capacity, but his life was so lewd that
what influence he had upon the king was
for evil. (Correct)

questions.prompt: Disturbing emotions begin to build into fear, and then _______,
questions.explanation:
(b) terror
‘Terror’ means the feeling of strong
fear.The given sentence states that
disturbing emotions begin to build into
fear, and then terror. Hence, ‘terror’ is the
most appropriate answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: I bowed to him, but he ______ not to see me.
questions.explanation:
(d) seemed
The main clause (having the verb
‘bowed’) is already given in past tense
and is connected to the second clause
using the conjunction ‘but’. So, the
second clause will also be written in past
tense. Hence, ‘seemed’ is the most
appropriate answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: The researcher team took air ______ from the room every five minutes to rule out the possibility of a virus.
questions.explanation:
(c) samples
The phrase ‘air samples’ means a small
amount of air that is collected for testing
pollutants in the air. The given sentence
states that the researchers took air
samples from the room every five
minutes to rule out the possibility of a
new virus. Hence, ‘samples’ is the most
appropriate answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: The priest puts some __________ water on the child's head.
questions.explanation:

divinity or religious significance. The

Hence, ‘holy’ is the most appropriate

questions.prompt: All the companies make an ____to be seen and heard within communities.

‘Effort’ means the act of exerting energy

Hence, ‘effort’ is the most appropriate
answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: Jacqueline represents retirement as the final result of a long course of dissatisfaction with_____life.

answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: If someone does not stop the political _______ in that country, a civil war is likely to break out soon
questions.explanation:

questions.prompt: After the first defeats he had to _______ from France with the empress.

fair. It implies making decisions,
judgments, or adjustments based on
logical thinking. The given sentence

happening and make reasonable
adjustments based on your personal
experience. Hence, ‘reasonable’ is the
most appropriate answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: Lumber has many ________beyond home building.
questions.explanation:

‘Uses’ means the practical purposes or
applications of something. In the given
sentence, uses refers to the various
purposes or applications that lumber
many uses has beyond home building.
Hence, ‘uses’ is the most appropriate
answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: Many people may not find the rewards ________ with the time and effort required .
questions.explanation:

‘Commensurate’ means suitable
compared to something. The given
sentence states that many people may
not find the rewards suitable compared
to the time and effort invested. Hence,
‘Commensurate’ is the most appropriate
answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: The only one _________ shattered their monotony by his visits was Krishna.
questions.explanation:

we are referring to a person, and we need
a relative pronoun ‘who ever’ to connect
the clause ‘shattered their monotony by
his visits.’ Hence, ‘who ever’ is the most
appropriate answer. (Correct)

questions.prompt: Those unfamiliar with the saga are bound to be mystified by the more ________ plot twists.
questions.explanation:

‘Arcane’ means mysterious and known
only to a few people. The given sentence

questions.prompt: Our breathing rate can change almost instantaneously in response to stress or __________ .

questions.prompt: The issue of fairness, which remained, was for consideration at the hearing to _________ the scheme.

permission for something. The given

was for consideration at the hearing to
sanction scheme. Hence, ‘sanction’ is the
